title: Flight consolidated type/export ownership table
scope: @flighthq/types packages/types/src declaration files (tests, index.ts, and contract.ts excluded)

rules.ownership: A symbol lives in the lowest package that must name it; later approved decisions override first-pass assignments.
rules.entity: root = Entity itself; direct = immediate interface/class heritage or top-level alias composition names Entity; factory = an exported create* factory explicitly returns concrete object type X & Entity; transitive = an interface/class or non-union alias reaches Entity through another declared symbol; union-of-entities = every union member is Entity but the union/enum itself has no runtime slot; intersections require any Entity operand; none = no Entity path.
rules.factoryEvidence: Only explicit exported create* return annotations in pinned non-test package source qualify, and X must be a concrete object interface/class or alias of an object. A union of non-Entity records does not qualify merely because one consumer returns X & Entity. Factory bodies, allocateEntity calls, parameters, embedded fields, arbitrary non-create return usage, dispatch infrastructure, and analogy to another backend do not create Entity identity.
rules.tsOnly: D11 owners: host-web/electron/tauri/capacitor, scene2d-dom/canvas, effects-canvas, textshaper-canvas, tool-*, sdk, and vite-plugin-manifest.
rules.declarationMerging: One row per file::symbol; every source declaration span is retained in sourceLocations.
